# Moonleaf

> Moonleaf is a free Android app (Android 7.0+) that saves web novels and fan fiction from Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net, AO3, Standard Ebooks and RoliaScan as EPUB files on the phone and reads them, or any EPUB the user already has, in a built-in reader inspired by KOReader. No account, no ads, no analytics; the library stays on the device. Distributed as an APK from GitHub, not Google Play.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
- Platform: Android 7.0 or later. APK download of about 160 MB. iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux builds are possible from source but not published.
- Supported sources: Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net and FictionPress (pages load in an in-app browser; the user may need to complete a Cloudflare human check), AO3 and Standard Ebooks (the site's own EPUB is downloaded), and RoliaScan. Text only, not image-only manga. Any EPUB file can also be imported. Wattpad is not supported because its terms prohibit scraping.
- What it does: paste a story's URL or a link to any chapter; Moonleaf adds it to the library and downloads the whole book automatically as an EPUB, with chapter names tidied to "Chapter N: Name". The novel page lists chapters Mihon-style (read chapters dimmed, tap to open, Resume). "Check for new chapters" updates the book; the EPUB can be saved for other apps.
- Reader features: paged or continuous view; font (including custom TTF/OTF), size, weight, line/word/letter spacing, indent, paragraph spacing, margins, justification; page colors Paper, Sepia, Sage, Dusk, Night, E-ink and E-ink dark; configurable tap zones, swipe, pinch-to-zoom text, and page turns with the volume buttons, keyboards, page-turner remotes or media keys; screen reader (TalkBack) support; configurable status bar; contents with page numbers; bookmarks; highlights with notes in several colors; full-text search; go to page or percent; footnote previews; dictionary, Wikipedia and translation look-ups in the browser; reading statistics and time-left estimates.
- Library: tabs for Library (cover grid or list with Plan to read / Reading / Completed shelves), Updates (downloads and new chapters, check all books at once), Reading (continue reading, recently opened, finished), Settings and Search. The design follows Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, fits phones down to 320 points wide and supports very large text and reduced motion.
- Privacy: all data (library, EPUBs, positions, highlights, statistics) is stored on the device. The app connects only to the novel sites the user chooses.
- Affiliation: independent project, not affiliated with KOReader, Mihon, Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net, AO3, Standard Ebooks or RoliaScan, and contains no code from KOReader or Mihon.
